Hi Tauhid,

I’m sorry, but the Classic Bulldog Tee in size S is currently out of stock, so I can’t confirm arrival by September 3. We’re arranging a restock and will follow up when we can confirm timing. If you’d like, the same tee is currently available in sizes M and L at $28 each. Would you prefer one of those sizes, or would you rather wait for size S?

Campus Customs Customer Service
